fields.evidence: Pacific Pulp supplies all 12 oz hot cups, about 2.1 million a year. Greenfold makes mailers only; the last cup RFQ was in 2024. Source: supplier master and contract register.

fields.title: Altura: Colombian harvest running three weeks late
fields.evidence: Call with Altura’s account manager. Rain delayed the Huila harvest; the January container may slip into February. They will hold the surcharge “for now” but would not put it in writing.
